cards.claim: Srini Krishnamurthy worked for Benedictine University.
cards.quote: In 2005, Krishnamurthy joined Benedictine University as a research fellow in the Department of Education. During his tenure at the university, he conducted several studies on the impact of technology on education and published numerous papers on the subject. One of his notable studies, "The Role of Technology in Enhancing Student Engagement" (2008), was widely cited and received critical acclaim. Krishnamurthy's work at Benedictine University was recognized by the university administration, and he was awarded the "Researcher of the Year" award in 2010. He continued to work at the university until 2015, when he left to pursue other opportunities.

cards.claim: Srini Krishnamurthy worked for the University of Chicago.
cards.quote: Krishnamurthy began his academic career as a research assistant at the University of Chicago, where he worked from 2001 to 2005. During this period, he was involved in several studies on educational psychology and pedagogy.
